messages:
ada: Quick q — how should routing pick an owner when token has both org_id and project_id and also a service_account claim? We're seeing requests routed to org default route and quota counted at org, but console shows project usage as 0. Any plan for consistent attribution?

sam: short answer: prefer "most-specific" resource: service_account > project > org. That way SA calls attach to SA and roll up to project/org for quotas. Current router picks org because we hash on org_id first; that's a legacy perf shortcut.

jia: agree with most-specific. Telemetry needs stable fields though — please emit both `effective_owner` and `matched_owner` (so audits can reconstruct). Example token claims we get:

```
{"iss":"https://id.redwood", "sub":"sa:analytics@proj-123", "proj":"proj-123", "org":"org-9", "scp":"infer:write"}
```

If router prefers org we lose project-level billing and console lookups fail.

sasha: console UX: show attribution chain. Right now users see project 0 because UI only reads top-level owner. Minimal change: show "attributed_to: proj-123 (via sa:analytics)" and tooltip with rule that matched.

kevin: quota enforcement side — enforcement should use `effective_owner` (most-specific) to check limits. Billing should be charged at project if present, otherwise org. Edge-case: cross-project SA impersonation — need to preserve original caller in telemetry so we can bill correctly.

authz-bot: FYI flagged anomalous requests: 235k requests this hour where token had both proj+org and router attributed to org. Investigating.

deploy-bot: rolling canary for flag `authz.priority_v2` to 10% starting in 30m :rocket:

sam: rollout plan proposal:
1) instrument telemetry fields (effective_owner, matched_owner, match_rule) behind flag
2) enable router heuristic behind flag (most-specific) + telemetry
3) canary 10% for 24h, monitor attribution diffs and quota hits
4) if stable, 100% and backfill attribution events for last 7d for billing reconciliation

ada: sounds good. One more: add dashboard panel in console and grafana showing "attribution delta" (count routed-to-org but with project claim). 👍

sasha: I'll wire a small console tile — show top 10 mismatches by org and proj. Need telemetry field names to be final.

jia: I'll add schema PR for the new fields and a quicklambda to enrich logs. Will send PR today.

kevin: I'll add enforcement change but keep honoring legacy org-first while in canary mode. Also add alert if quota consumption shifts >20% after rollout.

ada: thanks everyone. tagging @sam for follow-up and @sasha for console tile. :thumbsup:
